arguments:
set -eu
repo=/srv/lowcost-europa
echo "STATIC_BEGIN"
sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD
echo "PUBLIC_TEMPLATE_ORIGIN_FIELDS"
if sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 grep -nE 'ship_from_country|is_ship_from_verified|ALLOWED_SHIP_FROM_COUNTRIES' "$repo/apps/storefront/templates/storefront/components/offer_card.html" "$repo/apps/storefront/templates/storefront/home.html"; then echo "FRONTEND_REFERENCE=YES"; else echo "FRONTEND_REFERENCE=NO"; fi
echo "PUBLIC_ELIGIBILITY"
sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 grep -n -E 'is_ship_from_verified|public_eligibility_q|is_active|affiliate_promotion_status|ship_from_country' "$repo/apps/catalog/services/public_eligibility.py"
echo "WEEKLY_CAP"
sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 grep -n -E 'PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY|pending_before >=' "$repo/apps/catalog/services/weekly_discovery.py"
echo "DISCOVERY_TIMER"
systemctl is-active lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.timer
echo "MAINTENANCE_TIMER"
systemctl is-active lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.timer
echo "STATIC_END"
